inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL migration adds a VIRTUAL generated VARBINARY prefix column using LEFT, CAST(... AS BINARY), and COALESCE.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Minimized independently authored reproduction over one nullable namespace row. It retains the ALTER TABLE generated-column definition and one observable generated-byte projection while removing the source migration guard, indexes, extra columns, and extra rows.

fixture_notes: One ordinary namespace value is enough to expose whether the generated binary prefix can be added and read.
determinism_notes: One fixed row and ordered scalar projection; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE label_registry (label_id INT PRIMARY KEY, namespace VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 NULL)

steps.sql: ALTER TABLE label_registry ADD COLUMN namespace_prefix VARBINARY(12) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (LEFT(CAST(COALESCE(namespace, '') AS BINARY), 12)) VIRTUAL
SELECT HEX(namespace_prefix) AS prefix_hex FROM label_registry ORDER BY label_id
